abstract: We estimate the impact of public pension incentives on labor supply far from the normal retirement age by exploiting Poland’s switch from a Defined Benefit to a Notional Defined Contribution (NDC) scheme. title: The long decline of trust in democratic institutions
title_zh: 民主制度信任的长期衰退
authors: Sam Peltzman
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-28 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: I document declining trust in the Executive and Legislative branches of the US federal government from 1972 onwards. Data are from General Social Survey questions asking whether respondents “have a great deal”, “only some,” or “hardly any” confidence “in those running these institutions”. Net confidence (percentage difference between “great deal” and “hardly any”) in the two branches has declined continually from nearly zero in the early 1970s, accelerating substantially from the 1990s on. Different processes drive this decline for each branch. Partisan and ideological opponents of the President increasingly distrust the incumbent while supporters are roughly neutral. Trust in the US Congress has been eroding more uniformly across all parties and ideologies. In recent years net confidence has been around -30 for the Executive and -45 for Congress. This profound distrust (10 times as many have hardly any v a great deal of confidence in Congress) is widely shared across main socio-demographics, such as age, gender, income, etc., though the decline is steeper for older and white respondents. The decline is also greater than for other institutions, including until recently the third branch (Supreme Court). I close by discussing implications for research in public choice.
abstract_zh: 本文记录了自1972年以来美国联邦政府行政与立法部门公信力持续下降的趋势。数据来源于综合社会调查中关于受访者对"这些机构管理者"信任程度的问题，选项包括"非常信任"、"部分信任"和"几乎不信任"。两部门的净信任度（"非常信任"与"几乎不信任"的百分比差值）从20世纪70年代初接近零的水平持续下滑，自20世纪90年代起加速恶化。不同部门公信力下降的驱动机制存在差异：总统的党派与意识形态反对者对其不信任程度持续加深，而支持者基本保持中立；美国国会的公信力则在所有党派与意识形态群体中呈现更均匀的侵蚀态势。近年来，行政部门的净信任度约为-30，国会约为-45。这种深度不信任（对国会"几乎不信任"的受访者数量是"非常信任"的十倍）广泛存在于年龄、性别、收入等主要社会人口学群体中，但老年群体和白人受访者的下降幅度更为显著。与其他机构（包括近期之前的第三部门——最高法院）相比，其下降幅度也更为突出。本文最后探讨了该现象对公共选择研究的启示。

title: The role of structural transformation in regional convergence in Japan: 1874–2008
title_zh: 日本区域趋同中的结构转型作用：1874–2008
authors: Kyoji Fukao, Saumik Paul
abstract: Japan's regional convergence of productivity levels throughout the twentieth century can be best described as a cumulative process of ‘catching up, forging ahead, and falling behind’. Using a novel dataset spanning 135 years (1874–2008), this study finds support for a crucial role played by structural transformation in convergence. The pace of productivity catch‐up and convergence accelerated in the mid‐1950s with the help of structural transformation, particularly in the period from 1955 to 1965. Structural transformation explains, on average, about 30 per cent of the aggregate productivity growth, and its effect intensified in prefectures with faster movements of labour across sectors and larger sectoral productivity gaps. However, since the early 1970s, its contribution to the convergence was frequently offset by within‐sector productivity growth, in turn thwarting the pace of convergence. These counter‐balancing effects contributed to the diverse pathways of productivity catch‐up at the prefecture level.
abstract_zh: 20世纪日本各区域生产率水平的收敛过程，可被最恰当地描述为“追赶、领先与落后”的累积性进程。本研究利用覆盖135年（1874-2008年）的新数据集，发现结构转型在收敛过程中发挥了关键作用。20世纪50年代中期，在结构转型的推动下，生产率追赶与收敛速度显著加快，尤其在1955年至1965年期间。结构转型平均解释了约30%的总体生产率增长，且其效应在劳动力跨部门流动更快、部门间生产率差距更大的县级行政区中更为显著。然而自20世纪70年代初以来，结构转型对收敛的贡献常被部门内生产率增长所抵消，进而阻碍了收敛进程。这些相互抵消的效应导致了县级层面生产率追赶路径的多元化。

title: The Elusive Link Between FDI and Economic Growth: Sectoral Heterogeneity and Global Value Chains
title_zh: 外商直接投资与经济增长之间难以捉摸的联系：部门异质性与全球价值链
authors: AgustÃ­n, BÃ©nÃ©trix,, Pallan, Hayley, Panizza, Ugo, Panizza, Ugo Gianluigi
official: 官方在线 2026-07-20 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This paper reassesses the relationship between foreign direct investment (FDI) and economic growth in emerging and developing economies. Using cross-country data, it first shows that the relationship between FDI, growth, and local conditions such as financial depth and human capital is not stable over time: complementarities documented in studies based on data from the 1970s and 1980s largely disappear in more recent decades. It then builds a new dataset on sectoral FDI covering 112 emerging and developing economies and documents substantial heterogeneity in the association between FDI and sectoral growth. FDI inflows are positively associated with growth in the primary sector, show no robust relationship in the secondary sector, and are negatively associated with growth in the tertiary sector. To interpret these patterns, we examine the role of global value chains (GVCs). We find that FDI is most strongly associated with growth in country-sectors with low GVC participation, while this relationship weakens or disappears as GVC integration increases. Moreover, the growth effects of FDI depend critically on the type of GVC integration. Backward participation amplifies the positive growth effects of FDI in the primary sector but attenuates them in the secondary sector and worsens the negative effects in tertiary sector, whereas forward participation strengthens the association between FDI and growth in manufacturing. Taken together, the results suggest that the elusive aggregate relationship between FDI and growth reflects a structural transformation in how foreign investment is embedded in global production networks: in highly fragmented value chains, FDI can expand gross activity without generating commensurate domestic value-added growth.
abstract_zh: 本文重新评估了外国直接投资（FDI）与新兴及发展中经济体经济增长之间的关系。基于跨国数据，本文首先发现FDI、经济增长与金融深化、人力资本等本地条件之间的关系随时间推移并不稳定：基于20世纪70年代和80年代数据的研究所揭示的互补性，在近几十年中基本消失。随后，本文构建了涵盖112个新兴及发展中经济体的部门层面FDI新数据集，并发现FDI与部门经济增长之间的关联存在显著异质性。FDI流入与第一产业增长呈正相关，与第二产业增长无稳健关联，与第三产业增长呈负相关。为解释这些模式，本文考察了全球价值链（GVC）的作用。研究发现，在GVC参与度较低的国别-部门中，FDI与经济增长的关联最为显著，而随着GVC一体化程度提高，这一关联减弱或消失。此外，FDI的增长效应关键取决于GVC一体化的类型。后向参与强化了FDI在第一产业的正向增长效应，但削弱了其在第二产业的效应并加剧了第三产业的负向效应；而前向参与则增强了FDI与制造业增长之间的关联。综合来看，研究结果表明，FDI与增长之间难以捉摸的总体关系，反映了外国投资嵌入全球生产网络方式的结构性转型：在高度碎片化的价值链中，FDI可能扩大总产出，却未能带来相应的国内增加值增长。

title: Non-Tariff Barriers in the U.S.-China Trade War
title_zh: 中美贸易战中的非关税壁垒
authors: Chen, Tuo, Hsieh, Chang-Tai, Song, Zheng (Michael)
official: 来源期次 American Economic Journal: Macroeconomics · 来源：期刊官网
abstract: Unofficial non-tariff barriers were responsible for 50% of the reduction in Chinese imports from the U.S. during the 2018-2019 trade war. We infer NTBs from the change in imports of U.S. products relative to imports from other countries of the same HS6 product, after controlling for the change in the relative price of U.S. imports. NTBs were imposed on a small number of agricultural products, did not apply to state-owned importers, and larger for products with a high share of state importers. NTBs are more costly compared to tariffs because they only apply to some importers do not generate revenues.
abstract_zh: 在2018-2019年贸易战期间，非官方非关税壁垒导致中国从美国进口减少的50%。我们通过控制美国进口相对价格变化后，比较美国产品进口变化与同一HS6产品从其他国家进口变化来推断非关税壁垒的存在。非关税壁垒仅针对少数农产品实施，不适用于国有进口商，且对国有进口商占比较高的产品影响更大。与关税相比，非关税壁垒成本更高，因其仅适用于部分进口商且不产生财政收入。

title: Competition between green and blue hydrogen and indirect network effects 1
title_zh: 绿色氢与蓝色氢的竞争及间接网络效应
authors: Kine Josefine Aurland-Bredesen, Rolf Golombek, Mads Greaker
source: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
abstract: Whereas hydrogen is currently a marginal energy carrier, the aim of the EU is to trigger low-carbon hydrogen production that covers around 10 percent of EU’s energy needs by 2050. If this comes true, it will be an energy revolution. We study competition between green and blue hydrogen using an extended Salop model that encompasses the value chains for hydrogen and CCS. For blue hydrogen, we distinguish between exports of blue hydrogen—natural gas is converted into hydrogen close to the extraction site of natural gas and hydrogen is then transported over a long distance to the hydrogen consumers—and local production of blue hydrogen—natural gas is exported over a long distance and then converted into hydrogen near the hydrogen consumers. We find that mark-ups are highest in the case of exports of blue hydrogen production, which implies that total production of hydrogen, supply of blue hydrogen, and share of plants investing in carbon capture facilities are lower in the case of exports of blue hydrogen than in the case of local production of blue hydrogen. We provide numerical simulations of the alternative market outcomes and the corresponding first-best outcomes and identify policy instruments that should be used to sustain the first-best social outcomes in the cases of exports of blue hydrogen and local production of blue hydrogen.
abstract_zh: 尽管氢能目前仍是一种边缘能源载体，欧盟的目标是到2050年推动低碳氢能生产，使其覆盖欧盟约10%的能源需求。若这一目标实现，将引发一场能源革命。我们通过扩展萨洛普模型（Salop model）研究绿色氢能与蓝色氢能之间的竞争，该模型涵盖了氢能与碳捕集与封存（CCS）的价值链。针对蓝色氢能，我们区分了两种模式：蓝色氢能出口（在天然气开采地附近将天然气转化为氢能，再通过长距离运输至氢能消费端）与蓝色氢能本地生产（将天然气长距离出口至氢能消费端附近，再转化为氢能）。研究发现，蓝色氢能出口模式下的加价幅度最高，这意味着相较于蓝色氢能本地生产模式，出口模式下的氢能总产量、蓝色氢能供应量以及投资碳捕集设施的工厂占比均更低。我们通过数值模拟对比了不同市场结果与对应的最优社会结果，并识别出在蓝色氢能出口与本地生产两种模式下，用于维持最优社会结果的政策工具。

title: The economic footprint of Europe’s defence build-up
title_zh: 欧洲防务建设的经济足迹
authors: Luiz de Mello, Ines Dezcallar, Sean Dougherty
abstract: Defence policy is usually discussed as a national security issue, but its economic effects are often highly local. This column presents new evidence from 1,011 regions in 15 European countries suggesting that places hosting defence production and supply chain activity have a larger economic footprint than comparable places without such activity: they enjoy higher income levels, and the premium is especially large in more innovative regions. As Europe raises defence spending, the geography of where that money ultimately lands may matter almost as much as the total amount.
abstract_zh: 国防政策通常被视为国家安全议题，但其经济效应往往具有高度地方性。本文基于15个欧洲国家1011个地区的新证据表明，承接国防生产及供应链活动的地区，其经济规模显著大于未开展此类活动的可比地区：这些地区享有更高收入水平，且在创新程度更高的地区，这种经济溢价尤为突出。随着欧洲增加国防开支，资金最终流向的地理分布可能与支出总额同等重要。

title: Understanding Cross-State Variations in Medicaid Enrollment During and After the COVID-19 Pandemic
title_zh: 新冠疫情期间及之后医疗补助参保率的跨州差异研究
authors: Jeffrey Clemens, Helena Detering, Anwita Mahajan
official: 官方在线 2026-07-02 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: The implementation and unwinding of the FFCRA's continuous coverage requirement generated historically large changes in Medicaid enrollment during the COVID-19 pandemic. Using a combination of descriptive and causal analyses, we examine the substantial cross-state differences in these changes, which remain little understood. We find that policies designed to ease unwinding frictions, as well as federal fiscal assistance to states, have little predictive power, suggesting limited roles for administrative design or liquidity constraints. Political preferences have modest predictive power during the unwinding period. Pandemic-era Medicaid expansions and more generous baseline eligibility thresholds are strongly associated with larger net enrollment gains.
abstract_zh: FFCRA持续覆盖要求的实施与解除，导致新冠疫情期间医疗补助计划参保人数出现历史性的大幅波动。通过结合描述性分析与因果分析，我们研究了各州在这些变化中存在的显著差异——这些差异至今仍鲜有深入理解。研究发现，旨在缓解解除摩擦的政策以及联邦对各州的财政援助，其预测能力均较弱，表明行政设计或流动性约束的作用有限。政治倾向在解除期间仅具有适度的预测能力。疫情期间医疗补助计划的扩展以及更宽松的基线资格门槛，与更大的净参保人数增长显著相关。

title: Optimal Currency Basket Estimation
title_zh: 最优货币篮子估计
authors: Mr. Etienne Vaccaro-Grange
official: 官方在线 2026-06-26 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Small open economies often anchor their exchange rate to a basket of foreign currencies, with weights typically set from trade shares or financial exposure. Such schemes ignore the heterogeneity of pass-through across currencies and the covariance structure of bilateral rates, and therefore do not minimize the volatility of imported inflation, the central bank’s mandate. This paper proposes a minimum-variance framework — formally analogous to a Markowitz portfolio problem in pass-through space — in which basket weights minimize the variance of exchange-rate-driven imported inflation, subject to a constraint that preserves the basket’s cumulative pass-through. Applied to the case of Fiji, an import-intensive island economy with a five-currency basket, the optimization reduces the variance of imported inflation by close to twenty percent, with results robust across alternative specifications.
abstract_zh: 小型开放经济体通常将本币汇率与一篮子外币挂钩，权重通常根据贸易份额或金融敞口设定。此类方案忽略了汇率传导在不同货币间的异质性以及双边汇率的协方差结构，因此无法最小化进口通胀的波动性——而这正是央行的政策目标。本文提出一个最小方差框架——在形式上类似于汇率传导空间中的马科维茨投资组合问题——在该框架下，一篮子货币的权重在保持篮子累积汇率传导效应的约束条件下，最小化汇率驱动的进口通胀方差。将该方法应用于斐济这一进口密集型岛国（其采用五货币篮子）的案例后，优化方案使进口通胀方差降低近20%，且结果在不同设定下均保持稳健。

title: Fertilising Climate Policy: The Dual Impact of CBAM on EU Agricultural Emissions and Regional Disparities
title_zh: 施肥气候政策：CBAM对欧盟农业排放与区域差异的双重影响
authors: Davit Stepanyan, Omid Zamani, Claudia Heidecke, Janine Pelikan, Jörg Rieger, Bernhard Osterburg 等
abstract: The Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism (CBAM), scheduled to become fully operational in 2026, is designed to complement the EU Emissions Trading System (ETS) by replacing free emission allowances and preventing carbon leakage to non‐EU regions. CBAM initially covers energy‐intensive sectors, including mineral nitrogen (N) fertiliser production. Although mineral N fertiliser production is already included in the EU ETS, it is currently exempt from carbon charges owing to full compensation through free allowances. The phase‐out of these allowances and the introduction of CBAM are expected to increase the prices of both imported and domestically produced fertilisers, indirectly affecting the EU agricultural sector. This study quantitatively assesses the impacts of the expected fertiliser price changes on the EU agricultural sector and related environmental outcomes using the Modular Applied GeNeral Equilibrium Tool (MAGNET) and the Common Agricultural Policy Regionalised Impact (CAPRI) model. The results indicate that the combined effect of phasing out free allowances and implementing CBAM will double mineral N fertiliser prices. Higher prices are projected to reduce demand, leading to a 21.4% decline in domestic production and a 37% reduction in imports. Overall mineral N fertiliser use in the EU is expected to decrease by 22%, partially replaced by manure. Consequently, EU agricultural factor income is projected to fall by 7.7%, primarily affecting high‐input regions. Meanwhile, non‐EU agricultural income is projected to rise slightly by 0.05%, driven by higher exports. EU agricultural greenhouse gas emissions are expected to decrease by 22 megatons of CO 2 ‐equivalent, with no significant increase globally.
abstract_zh: 碳边境调节机制（CBAM）计划于2026年全面实施，旨在通过取代免费排放配额并防止碳泄漏至非欧盟地区，对欧盟排放交易体系（ETS）形成补充。CBAM最初覆盖能源密集型行业，包括矿物氮肥生产。尽管矿物氮肥生产已被纳入欧盟ETS，但目前因通过免费配额获得全额补偿而免于碳成本。这些配额的逐步取消及CBAM的引入预计将推高进口和本土化肥价格，间接影响欧盟农业部门。本研究采用模块化应用一般均衡工具（MAGNET）与共同农业政策区域化影响模型（CAPRI），定量评估预期化肥价格变化对欧盟农业部门及相关环境结果的影响。结果表明，取消免费配额与实施CBAM的叠加效应将使矿物氮肥价格翻倍。价格上涨预计将抑制需求，导致本土产量下降21.4%，进口量减少37%。欧盟矿物氮肥总使用量预计下降22%，部分被粪肥替代。受此影响，欧盟农业要素收入预计下降7.7%，高投入地区受冲击最为显著。与此同时，非欧盟地区农业收入因出口增长预计小幅上升0.05%。欧盟农业温室气体排放预计减少2200万吨二氧化碳当量，且全球范围内未出现显著增长。
